Corollary
[Homotopy, diffeomorphism, and isometry] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0213 ↗ thm:chow-iv-mostow-rigidity 1. ch31:31.50\group Mostow rigidity

For finite-volume hyperbolic manifolds of dimension at least three, being homotopy equivalent, diffeomorphic, and isometric are equivalent conditions; volume is therefore a topological invariant.
